newsitem.title: USA: Advent effects 1-100 reverse stock split.
newsitem.headline: Advent effects 1-100 reverse stock split.

text.p: Advent Technologies Inc said on Monday that its board has effected a 1 for 100 reverse stock split following the company's acquisition of NewReach Communications Inc last week.
The board kept authorized common shares at 60 million and preferred shares at 5 million, the company said.
The board also approved a name change to NewReach Communications Inc and elected to seek a symbol change from AVTI.

Advent said it issued 3,880,278 shares of authorized-but- unissued post-split common shares for all issued and outstanding shares of NewReach. The new capitalization of Advent has 4,428,871 shares issued and outstanding, of which 126,780 shares are publicly trading, the company said.
